text: yopi hetu yopi paccayo dhammānaṃ uppādāya sopi dukkho dukkhasambhūtā bhikkhave dhammā kuto sukhā bhavissanti . evaṃ passaṃ .pe. nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . navamaṃ . #1 yu. sabbattha cakkhuṃ .
